meta.title: Scout v2 — mechanical assembly sequence with checks

cards.title: Steps (off-the-shelf parts only)
items: 01 Bottom plate + motor brackets + 4 Hiwonder encoder motors + wheels
02 Lower-deck power: battery on the centre of rotation, XT30, fuse holder, 5 V buck
03 ESP32 at the rear of the lower deck · 04 deck pillars
05 Top-plate bench pre-fit: MDD3A on nylon standoffs underneath, IMU near the CoR, switch
06 Top plate on + wiring · 07 Pi 5 + Active Cooler on standoffs, Camera Module 3 at the front tilted 15° down, HC-SR04 under the front edge
08 LiDAR tower (M2.5 standoffs + plate) with RPLIDAR C1, scan plane ~150 mm · 09 payload cup Ø75 × 80 mm with 4-standoff fence at x = −50 mm

cards.title: Checks, steps 01–04
items: 01 Wheels spin free; 1 mm nylon washer behind a wheel if it rubs (wheel–plate gap 1.57 mm)
02 Battery centred on the centre of rotation; XT30 polarity checked before the fuse goes in; ≥2.2 mm side clearance
03 ESP32 at the rear clears the encoder connectors and the XT30/fuse
04 Pillars square, no wire pinched under the top plate (assumed check)

cards.title: Checks, steps 05–07
items: 05 Bench pre-fit before mounting: MDD3A on nylon standoffs underneath, IMU within 25 mm of the CoR (x ≈ −25 mm), ≥10 A DC switch cut-out drilled
06 Polarity check, then multimeter: 5.0 V at the buck output with the Pi unplugged
07 Pi boots; vcgencmd get_throttled = 0x0; camera sees the floor ≤150 mm ahead; HC-SR04 does not block the camera FOV

cards.title: Checks, steps 08–09
items: 08 Scan plane ~150 mm, ≥5 mm above every robot part; tower–cooler gap (0.75 mm in CAD) checked on the real cooler
09 Cup + plant within Ø75 × 80 mm (else LiDAR rear-sector shadow); 4-standoff fence holds the 300 g cup; CoM x ≥ −22 mm
